item.title: Watch: Riot police clash with school protesters and use tear gas in France
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of people have taken to the streets across France amid a wave of protests by high-school pupils.

item.title: How toxic haze is causing Singapore’s landmarks to disappear

item.title: 'House of Horrors': California couple accused of abusing surrogate-born children

item.title: Cornell rape case accuser has received ‘threats’, attorney tells BBC Newsnight
item.description: Thomas Giuffra is representing a woman, known in legal documents as Jane Doe, who alleges she was raped at a frat house on campus in 2024.

item.title: The Republican candidates walking a Trump tightrope

item.title: Many Nepalis swept away in the floods aren't officially dead, leaving families in limbo
item.description: Relatives are finding themselves with no compensation and facing an administrative nightmare.

item.title: Why Zimbabwe tycoon 'Sir Wicknell' was loved and hated in Africa

item.title: Former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro expected to face more charges this week

item.title: Trump wants a new Camp David-like retreat at his Florida golf club
item.description: Trump's estate would stand in stark contrast to the rustic Camp David and mark another tradition transformed by Trump.

item.title: New York court hears arguments in ongoing 9/11 families' lawsuit against Saudi Arabia
item.description: The families allege that men with links to the Saudi government helped those who carried out the 2001 attacks, something the country denies.

item.title: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked nationwide protests dies

item.title: Texas carries out first US execution since Christa Pike's botched lethal injections
item.description: Lawyers for Jamaal Howard had asked a judge to pause the execution after Christa Pike's botched lethal injections.

item.title: Most UK diplomats to leave East Jerusalem consulate, Israel says, as Miliband says 'vital services' to remain
item.description: Israel said in September it would act in response to UK sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank.

item.title: US and Lebanon protecting wanted Syrian general, BBC finds
item.description: Bassam al-Hassan, linked to reporter Austin Tice's abduction, is being sheltered in return for information.
